Peter "stanislaw" Jarguz (born March 22, 1994) is a Canadian professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player of Polish descent. [1]

Trivia

[edit]
  • He can speak English and Polish.
  • His nickname came from his middle name, Stanisław.

Interviews

[edit]
  • 2017-09-09 | stanislaw: "There's a really good balance between me and nitr0" by Striker of HLTV at ESG Tour Mykonos 2017
  • 2019-12-05 | stanislaw: "ECS lit a spark in us; we showed we're not playing as badly as we thought" by Aleksei.L of HLTV at ESL Pro League Season 10 - Finals
  • 2020-02-24 | stanislaw: Winning in front of a Polish audience would mean a lot to me by Marcin Gabren of Cybersport.pl at Intel Extreme Masters XIV - World Championship
  • 2020-08-29 |  Интервью со stanislaw: Evil Geniuses — самая сильная команда по CS:GO в мире? [Interview with stanislaw: Evil Geniuses — the strongest CS:GO team in the world?] by KvintUA of Gameinside.ua at ESL One: Cologne 2020 Online - North America (trans. )
  • 2021-01-19 | stanislaw: "We need to rise to the occasion and meet the standard that has been set in Europe" by LucasAM of HLTV at BLAST Premier: Global Final 2020
  • 2021-06-15 | stanislaw: "I'm proud to say that we didn't give up, and I think our belief at this moment is the highest it's been in the past year" by LucasAM of HLTV at BLAST Premier: Spring Finals 2021
  • 2024-11-27 | stanislaw: "I have given everything that I have over the last year to get to where I am" by rizegeeko of Strafe Esports at Perfect World Shanghai Major 2024
